description: Publish immediately (`publish_now`), schedule for a future ISO-8601 timestamp (`schedule`), enqueue into the profile slot queue (`queue`), or simultaneously cross-post (`cross_post`) content and media across 18+ social networks. Includes the built-in X Smart Link Optimizer (`xLinkStrategy: 'first_reply'`), which automatically strips external links from the main X post and publishes them in an immediate 1st reply—cutting X API link costs by 85% ($0.03 vs $0.20) while avoiding main-feed link reach penalties. Returns the persisted `postId`, per-platform delivery receipts (`platformResults`), total API cost (`totalCostUsd`), and exact dollar savings (`totalSavedViaSmartLinkUsd`).

accountId.description: Optional connected account id (`acc_...`) to publish with. When set, that exact account (and its token) is used for its platform instead of auto-selecting one.

action.description: Publishing mode: 'publish_now' dispatches immediately, 'cross_post' syndicates tailored variants across multiple networks at once, 'schedule' holds until `scheduledFor`, and 'queue' places the post in the next best engagement slot.

authModeOverride.description: Optional authentication override forcing delivery through 'managed' Nuntior OAuth credentials or 'byok' customer-supplied keys.

autoAdjustMedia.description: When true, automatically selects the matching aspect-ratio variant (9:16 for Reels/TikTok/Shorts, 16:9 or 1:1 for X/LinkedIn) for each target platform.

content.description: Primary post body text, caption, or thread hook. May include hashtags, mentions, and URLs (external URLs on X are automatically handled according to `xLinkStrategy`).

firstComment.description: Optional first comment or reply to publish immediately under the main post.

format.description: Publication format. 'post' (default) is a regular feed post. 'story' publishes an Instagram Story: requires platforms=['instagram'], action='publish_now', exactly ONE media item (one entry in `mediaUrls` or `mediaAssetIds`; image .jpg/.png or video .mp4/.mov, ideally 9:16, video 3-60s) and NO caption (omit `content` or pass an empty string). Videos are processed by Instagram before going live.

mediaAssetIds.description: Optional list of Nuntior media asset IDs (`med_...`) from `media_pipeline` or `/v1/media/upload` to attach as images, PDF document carousels, or videos.

mediaUrls.description: Optional direct URLs to images (.png, .jpg, .webp), videos (.mp4, .mov), or documents (.pdf, .pptx, .docx for LinkedIn Document Carousels).

platforms.description: Non-empty array of destination social network slugs to publish or cross-post to (e.g. `['x', 'linkedin', 'bluesky', 'threads']`).

profileId.description: Brand profile identifier (`prof_...`) whose connected social accounts will publish the post.

scheduledFor.description: Optional ISO-8601 UTC or offset timestamp (e.g. '2026-10-27T08:30:00+01:00') specifying when a scheduled post should go live.

tags.description: Optional tags or keywords for YouTube, TikTok, or CMS posts.

title.description: Optional headline, YouTube/TikTok video title, LinkedIn PDF carousel title, or Reddit/Pinterest post title.

visibility.description: Optional visibility setting (e.g. 'public' or 'connections' on LinkedIn; 'public', 'unlisted', or 'private' on YouTube/TikTok).

webhookUrl.description: Optional https URL that receives a JSON post.published / post.failed / post.partial event when an Instagram/Threads post that returned status 'processing' (media container still being processed by Meta) is finished by the background job.

xLinkStrategy.description: X (Twitter) link optimization mode: 'first_reply' moves any URL to an automated 1st reply to save $0.17/post (85% X API cost reduction) and maximize organic impressions; 'inline' leaves the URL in the main tweet; 'bio' replaces the URL with a bio pointer.
